question: Which organisation has partnered with Sagar Defence to develop India’s first underwater-launched unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has collaborated with Sagar Defence to develop India's first underwater-launched unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).
 
• This collaboration aims to enhance India's defense capabilities with advanced technological solutions.
 
• The underwater-launched UAVs are designed to be deployed from submarines and other underwater platforms.
 
• These UAVs will provide strategic advantages in surveillance, reconnaissance, and other defense operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DRDO**

 
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) is an agency under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
 
• It is responsible for the development of technology for use by the military, including aeronautics, armaments, electronics, land combat engineering, life sciences, materials, missiles, and naval systems.
 
• DRDO was established in 1958 and has its headquarters in New Delhi, India.
 
 
 
• **Sagar Defence Engineering**
 
 
• Sagar Defence Engineering is an Indian startup focused on providing cutting-edge defense technology solutions.
 
• It specializes in developing autonomous vehicles and other defense-related technologies.
 
• The company aims to enhance India's maritime and defense capabilities with indigenous innovations.
 
 
 
• **Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs)**
 
 
• UAVs, commonly known as drones, are aircraft without a human pilot on board.
 
• They are used for various applications, including surveillance, reconnaissance, and targeted strikes in military operations.
 
• UAVs offer the advantage of remote operation and can be deployed in dangerous environments without risking human lives.
 
 
 
• **Underwater-launched UAVs**
 
 
• These UAVs are designed to be deployed from underwater platforms such as submarines.
 
• They provide strategic advantages in stealth and surprise operations, making them valuable assets for naval forces.
 
• The development of underwater-launched UAVs represents a significant technological advancement in modern warfare.
